ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs (MoTA), Government of India
disclaimer: This dataset covers 30+ programs, sub-schemes, institutional missions, and historical frameworks under MoTA. Central SC schemes are handled separately by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

schemes.name: Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan (DAJGUA)
schemes.description: A massive flagship saturation program covering over 63,000 tribal-majority villages to bridge critical social infrastructure, health, and livelihood gaps.

schemes.name: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM-JANMAN)
schemes.description: A cross-ministry micro-mission executing 11 absolute basic infrastructure interventions (housing, solar power, telecom) across remote PVTG habitations.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana (PMVKY)
schemes.description: The overarching core framework that orchestrates convergence, resource allocation, and specialized programmatic outputs across all state tribal departments.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Vikas Mission (PMJVM)
schemes.description: An integrated mission dedicated to scaling up the market value chain, enterprise incubation, and minimum support price infrastructure for tribal produce.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAAGY)
schemes.description: Focuses on developing model tribal villages by filling critical needs in sanitation, education, and water. Currently migrating operational targets into the DAJGUA framework.

schemes.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
schemes.description: Financial stipends awarded to under-privileged tribal students enrolled in Classes 9 and 10 to restrict high drop-out rates.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
schemes.description: 100% centrally assisted direct funding given to eligible ST students pursuing higher education from Class 11 up to postgraduate levels.

schemes.name: National Fellowship for Higher Education of ST Students
schemes.description: Provides financial fellowship support directly to meritorious ST scholars working toward university M.Phil and Ph.D. research programs.

schemes.name: National Overseas Scholarship (NOS) for ST Candidates
schemes.description: Covers tuition fees, travel, and living stipends for brilliant tribal students selected to pursue master's and doctoral degrees abroad.

schemes.name: Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS)
schemes.description: A growing, fully funded network of middle and high-school residential campuses aimed at providing modern education to tribal children in rural areas.

schemes.name: Development of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs)
schemes.description: A targeted funding line designated under PMVKY for protective socio-economic mapping and livelihood survival models across the 75 identified PVTGs.

schemes.name: Support to Tribal Research Institutes (TRIs)
schemes.description: Administrative and developmental funding given to state-level TRIs to document indigenous languages, cultural history, and conduct diagnostic policy audits.

schemes.name: Centers of Excellence (CoEs) Funding Scheme
schemes.description: Grants to elite institutes and universities to conduct research on specific tribal medicine, bio-resource utilization, and anthropological mapping.

schemes.name: Vocational Training in Tribal Areas
schemes.description: Sub-scheme setting up dedicated vocational training clusters inside tribal districts to promote market-linked technical skill sets.

schemes.name: Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs)
schemes.description: Livelihood clusters helping tribal Self Help Groups process, pack, and branding locally sourced Minor Forest Produce (MFP).

schemes.name: Institutional Support for Development and Marketing of Tribal Products
schemes.description: Strategic budgetary framework implemented via TRIFED to run modern retail networks, exhibitions, and international expos for tribal art.

schemes.name: NSTFDC Term Loan Scheme
schemes.description: Low-interest credit lines up to fixed limits extended to individual tribal micro-entrepreneurs setting up small trade operations.

schemes.name: Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana (AMSY)
schemes.description: Highly subsidized term financing mapped explicitly to support income-generating activities run by Scheduled Tribe women.

schemes.name: Micro Credit Scheme for Self Help Groups
schemes.description: Provides immediate, small working capital loans to tribal self-help configurations via state channelizing agencies.

schemes.name: Adivasi Shiksha Rinn Yojana
schemes.description: A highly subsidized educational loan product tailored to finance professional, technical, and graduate coursework in India.

schemes.name: Tribal Forest Dwellers Empowerment Scheme
schemes.description: Low-interest capital advances provided to forest dwellers to help cultivate lands granted under the Forest Rights Act (FRA).

schemes.name: Teak Growers Scheme / Agro-Forestry Credit
schemes.description: Specialized long-term concessional financing windows provided to encourage block commercial tree farming and homestead agro-forestry.

schemes.name: Going Online as Leaders (GOAL) Program
schemes.description: A digitally integrated mentorship drive aimed at scaling tech literacy, entrepreneurship, and digital skills among tribal youth.

schemes.name: Swasthya: Tribal Health and Nutrition Portal
schemes.description: A unique dashboard and repository documenting tribal medical dashboards, nutritional data, and localized epidemiological insights.

schemes.name: Adi Prashikshan Portal
schemes.description: A central training platform intended to act as an educational warehouse for training institutional stakeholders, PRI members, and master trainers.

schemes.name: Special Central Assistance to Tribal Sub-Scheme (SCA to TSS)
schemes.description: The original core funds released annually as an additive to state tribal sub-plans. Restructured and formally converted into PMAAGY.

schemes.name: Grants under First Proviso to Article 275(1) of the Constitution
schemes.description: Historical constitutional grants issued to state administrations for funding capital projects. Infrastructure allocations are now integrated into PMVKY.

schemes.name: Top Class Education for ST Students
schemes.description: A distinct scholarship pool tracking professional degrees in premier institutes. Fully merged into the modern National Fellowship & Scholarship umbrella.
